title: Identity write request v1
description: Two writes. `fgos identity machine --alias <name>` replaces <stateRoot>/machine-alias atomically; the alias must follow the Convention machine-handle kind, changes the handle only, never the machine id, and needs a machine id to exist. `fgos identity project --init|--new [--handle <name>]` writes .fgos/project.json of the main checkout: `--init` mints once and refuses when the file exists (project-id-exists), in a linked worktree (linked-worktree) or when the remote default branch, as last fetched, already tracks the file (project-id-on-remote); `--new` replaces the id on purpose (a fork split) and skips the last two checks. The handle follows the Convention project-handle kind and defaults to the slug of the folder name. Nothing else ever writes the file.

outcome.title: Identity write outcome v1
outcome.description: The machine as `identity.read` prints it after an alias write, or the project minted with where it went and the command that commits it.

commit.description: The command that commits the new file by pathspec.
